The '''Golbah hive''' was an outlying [[Geonosian hive/Legends|hive]] of [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] that built [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|IG-227 ''Hailfire''-class droid tanks]] for the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and experimented with adding chemical weapons to them. When the Golbah drones revolted<ref name="GatORW" /> due to intense physical pressures to keep up with harsh schedules, the planet's aristocracy made an example of them by dropping a [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bomb]], obliterating the entire hive<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|350|Golbah hive}}</ref> and creating the chemically volatile [[Golbah's Pit]] on the former site of their spire-hive.<ref name="GatORW" /> The Queen and all of her backups were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the blast.<ref name="CSWE" />
